name: Primal Spellcasting (Conduit Force of Nature)
body:
Primal spellcasting abilities revolve around using your force of nature to empower your spellcasting.

Primal Spellcasting (Sp)

You can expend a primal point to cast any connection spell provided by your force of nature without expending a spell slot. You cannot apply any metamagic to this spell, you must be able to normally cast the spell, and you can’t use this ability to cast a spell higher than 5th level.

Primal Metamagic (Su)

Prerequisite(s): primal spellcasting primal ability.

You have learned how to use your primal energies to manipulate spells as you cast them. As a swift action, you may apply any metamagic feat you possess to a spell without increasing the casting time or level of the spell.

To do so requires the expenditure of 1 primal point per level increase required by the metamagic feat. This may be used to apply multiple metamagic feats to a single spell if the primal points are available and normal application of metamagic feats is allowed in conjunction with this primal ability. The resultant spell can’t have metamagics applied that, if unmodified by this ability, would make the adjusted spell level higher than the highest spell level you can cast. Spells modified in this way should have some manifestation that represents a force of nature connected to.

Reduced Re-Infusion (Su)

Prerequisite(s): Conduit level 7.

You have eased the connection between the raw primal power of your connection and your spellcasting. The amount of spell levels required to regain 1 primal point is reduced to 4.

Spellcasting Infusion (Su)

Prerequisite(s): primal spellcasting primal ability.

You have learned how to insert primal energies into your spellcasting to add new effects. By expending a primal point as a free action while casting a spell you may apply an extra effect depending upon your force of nature as shown below:

Fauna – Any harmless spell you cast upon an ally may provide a +2 enhancement bonus to Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or natural armor (chosen when the spell is cast). The duration of this extra effect is the duration of the original spell. If the spell is instantaneous, the benefit lasts for 1 round per class level.
Flames – You may substitute the elemental damage of any spell cast with fire damage.
Land – Any earth-subtype spell or spell that mentions earth, stone, or metal (like stoneskin or others at the GM’s discretion) cast by you has it’s CL increased by 1 and does not require material components.
Ocean – Any water-subtype spell or spell that affects water creatures, survival in water, or movement in water cast by you has it’s CL increased by 1 and does not require material components.
Rime – You may substitute the elemental damage of any spell with cold damage.
Sky – Any air-subtype spell or spell that allows flight or other movement through the air cast by you has it’s CL increased by 1 and does not require material components.
Verdant – You may cast any spell through a plant within 30 feet of you as long as you are touching another plant. For example, you may deliver a touch spell through a bush that the target is passing through or a ray may be delivered from a nearby tree branch.
Spellcasting Infusion, Greater (Su)

Prerequisite(s): spellcasting infusion primal ability.

Your practice of suffusing your spellcasting with primal energy has had a permanent effect on your spellcasting.

You gain a special effect on any qualifying spell you cast so long as you have a primal point remaining in your pool. The benefit depends upon your force of nature as shown below:

Fauna – The number of rounds available to be distributed by any communal spell you cast is doubled. This does not stack with the Extend Spell feat.
Flames – Any spell that deals fire damage deals +1 fire damage per die of damage dealt. This stacks with the benefit granted by your force of nature.
Land – Any stone, dirt or metal object or structure created or molded by your spells has it’s hardness and hit points doubled.
Ocean – All spells cast by you are not affected by casting underwater. For example, fire spells operate normally for you and ranged touch spells do not have any penalties.
Rime – Any spell that deals cold damage deals +1 cold damage per die of damage dealt. This stacks with the benefit granted by your force of nature.
Sky – Any air-subtype spell cast by you has its DCs to resist its effects increased by 1. Additionally, the distance pushed by any wind effect is increased by 10 feet. The bonus to DC stacks with any feat that increases the Dcs of the spell.
Verdant – Any spell cast by you affecting or involving plants has its duration automatically extended as per the Extend Spell metamagic feat or empowered per the Empower Spell metamagic feat (chosen when the spell is cast), without increasing the casting time or spell level. This does not affect spells cast through plants per the spellcasting infusion primal ability unless it targets plants or has a plant effect.
